Gen AI Engineers
Experience: 6+ Years


Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop GenAI solutions using advanced prompt engineering techniques

Build and manage agentic workflows, including self-healing and autonomous agents

Develop and optimize RAG pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual

responses

Work with LangChain/LlamaIndex frameworks to orchestrate LLM-based

applications

Manage and maintain knowledge bases for accurate and scalable information retrieval

Implement conversational AI systems with strong reasoning capabilities

Integrate MCP servers and ensure smooth system communication

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions

Mandatory Skills:

Prompt Engineering, Agentic Workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),

LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP Servers, Conversational AI, Knowledge Base Management,

Python, API Integration

Min Qualification: Bachelor s

Location : Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Indore
